usedFor: MyDocSafe holds signed documents and HubSpot holds contacts, so “Document is Signed” can run “Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Document is Signed” in MyDocSafe, then “Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Once every party has signed, the contact in HubSpot is updated, so sales sees it without asking.

watchOut: “Update Contact” in HubSpot finds the contact by email, so the signer’s email must match a contact.
